summary: Honest dry-stop (the era's 3rd proposer pass; J-11 and J-12 came from passes 1 and 2 and are both green). NO hold-out survivor is even screenable: state/pnl-scan.json still does not exist (no post-goal hook wrote one), the champion pointer is still v1/default (journal champion_pointer row) and both founding pnl-history rows are n=1 < the configured promotion minimum 5 (config.promotion_min_sample_size), so guidance section 4 permits only dataset or surface work. DATASET work is unavailable: the library did grow to 98 datasets / 26 GB, but all 80 J-06 tranche shards fall inside the registered universe rule (8 symbols x 10 dates) and are therefore withheld as one unresolved opaque pool (vault.unresolved_pool_dataset_ids), leaving the same 17 exploratory legacy datasets; the session's standing bars are 'no new real tape, no sealed-shard reveal/assign, no studies on the real corpus', and the ~150-symbol-day gate is reported honestly unmet (80/150) BY DESIGN (T-7). Re-proposing the backlogged W3 champion sweep is barred by guidance section 7 -- no materially new evidence since it was recorded. VISION-GAP SCAN: no uncovered claim. All five Vision pillars map to passing journeys (1 readiness->J-01, 2 observer/snapshots->J-02+J-12, 3 structure x flow->J-03, 4 Scout/walk-forward/vault->J-04/J-05/J-06, 5 graduation->J-07+J-11) and all nine Key Capabilities are covered (9's four /desk sections + MCP v6 shipped in J-08, now 28 tools). ONE coverage observation, recorded to the backlog and DECLINED rather than promoted: 'Recorder job + tranche progress/runs' is the last Data-Contract row with zero readers (grep: 0 hits for micro/recorder in the frontend, no recorder tool in EXPECTED_TOOLS) -- declined because the real store has no micro_recorder_runs directory (the J-06 tranche ran through scripts/j06_operator.py into reports/j06-tranche/recording-runs.json: 5 runs, 80 recorded pairs, 2 failed), so a section would print 'no recorder runs' beside a Validation Vault showing 21 sealed shards from those runs -- an empty state that misdescribes history; the log is documented as 'convenience bookkeeping, never a claim of record'; and an auto-polling reader of the live progress route is exactly the composed-leak threat model owner ruling r5 + TR-32 closed. Manufacturing a 13th journey of that value would breach the enhancement-loop anti-goal, so docs/goal.md is left byte-untouched; the iter-33 evaluator's own recommendation (halt; everything left is a photograph or a walkthrough of already-proven work) stands.
